description: 5 exemplars + 3 near-misses + 2 counterexamples. Authored 2026-10-18 under road-to-steps-the-skill-cannot-skip AC-1, which repaired dead links in this skill's SKILL.md and so brought it into check_routing_coverage's touched-skill scope. Exemplars cover the ship-gate moment the skill claims: implementation complete, deciding merge / PR / park / discard, an idle branch whose fate is open, including a German 'fertig, was jetzt' phrasing. Near-misses use the skill's own named exclusion (a PR mid-review → receiving-code-review) plus two neighbours on the same branch lifecycle: resolving merge conflicts (merge-conflicts) and worktree cleanup after the fact (worktree-lifecycle). Counterexamples guard 'finish' on unrelated work and a git question with no branch-ending decision.

queries.q: the feature is done, all commits are in — what's next, merge or PR?
I think this bug fix branch is complete, let's ship it
this branch has been sitting for two weeks, help me decide whether to park or discard it
verify everything and wrap up the branch so I can hand it off
Implementierung ist fertig — prüf alles und sag mir, ob wir mergen, einen PR aufmachen oder den Branch verwerfen
the reviewer left twelve comments on my open PR, work through them
queries.note: named in this skill's own Do-NOT list — a PR already mid-review → receiving-code-review

queries.q: rebasing onto main gave me conflicts in three files, resolve them
queries.note: same branch lifecycle, but conflict resolution rather than the ship decision → merge-conflicts

queries.q: clean up the worktrees from last week's spikes
queries.note: removing worktrees, not routing a finished branch → worktree-lifecycle

queries.q: finish writing the migration for the orders table
queries.note: the 'finish' homonym while still implementing, which this skill's Do-NOT list excludes

queries.q: how do I rename a local branch?
queries.note: a git mechanics question with no completed work to route
